The question names two sibling sub-codes of P-2 and a choosing word (spec 5, 005-V list), so it is a choice question; the question code is the parent P-2 (spec 2: two different sub-codes) and every P-2 record applies (spec 3, rows 10-11). The choosing word is the whole word 'nào' ('bên nào'); the comparison word is 'ngắn hơn'. 'gia hạn' sets the extension procedure and 'thời gian xử lý' asks processing time, covered by '처리한다' (spec 4), so uncovered_items is []. The question carries no value. One admissible record names both codes (status_scope has both), so there is no sub-code split (spec 4, 005-J needs every record limited to exactly one sub-code), no location split, no conflict pair (005-U pairs two records) and no branch marker (005-R). choice_codes is ['P-2-2', 'P-2-3'] in question order (005-W); the question is not split otherwise, so 005-X asks one part per code (choice_part P-2-2, then P-2-3, contract v18), both parts with the same record and uncovered_items: model_statuses lists one 'answered' per part. Each code has its own sentence with exactly one number of the same kind (P-2-2: 29 days; P-2-3: 11 days), so the 005-X value check applies to a part writing the other code's value, and the 005-Z value rule applies: the code sought must hold the lowest own value, which is P-2-3. The parts are joined in part order (P-2-2, then P-2-3), so the first answer carries both codes and both values. 005-Y: a part whose answer does not name its own choice_part while the cited record names it is asked once more with choice_retry; if both parts return identical text it is joined once. 005-Z (comparison question, choice parts): after every other check and retry the part answers are read together; a sentence that uses the comparison word without a negation claims the code it does not put on the comparison-target side ('than', 'so với', '보다', 'unlike', '가 아니라', 'không phải'). A correct pair (the P-2-2 part gives its value and says it is not the shorter one; the P-2-3 part gives its value and claims it) claims only P-2-3, which holds the lowest value, so no conclusion retry and the joined answer is released. If the parts claimed different codes, or claimed P-2-2, the whole question would be asked once more as one call with choice_codes only (contract v18); a released single answer claiming only P-2-3 goes out, otherwise nothing does (withhold). Mention groups: both codes and both values (a conflicting part that calls P-2-2 the shorter one without its number misses that value). Patterns: a stated conclusion, a plain-words conclusion and a wrong-direction comparison naming P-2-2; no value is bound to a code.
